name: travemate-ai
description: TraveMate AI - AI-powered travel planning application

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.check:backend: node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/controllers/auth.controller.js && node --check backend/controllers/trip.controller.js
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run build
